encoding.notes: Literal original Print=0476, Using=04a6, semicolon=0064, string=0026 and integer=003e words; lengths and physical-line bytes assembled without production encoders or token tables.

evidence.notes: Integer digits are consumed backwards with blank padding and overflow truncation; explicit sign slots use the leading sign/space. String tildes consume characters and pad with blanks. Source analysis, not an Amiga execution capture.
